basis: Cysteine-rich transmembrane-domain protein (uncharacterized); sorghum HCR in phloem files, strong (Guillotin et al. 2023 Nature ED Fig 8i, Fig 2b); phloem DE pct 0.38 vs 0.01; maize ortholog Zm00001d019069 also phloem by HCR (same study).

ALTERED PHLOEM DEVELOPMENT ortholog (Ensembl Compara: AT1G79430), MYB required for phloem identity (Bonke et al. 2003 Nature); sorghum phloem DE pct 0.39 vs 0.01 (Guillotin et al. 2023 Nature). Not validated in sorghum; SE vs CC not split.

Callose synthase 7-like (GSL7); AtCalS7 makes sieve-plate callose in sieve elements (Barratt et al. 2011 PNAS). Weakly enriched across Phloem, Stele_2 and Young_Phloem (pct 0.30-0.34 vs 0.07; Guillotin et al. 2023 Nature): marks protophloem SE, absent from mature SE in nuclei data.
Phloem protein 2 family lectin; sorghum phloem DE pct 0.52 vs 0.04, and among the conserved maize-sorghum-Setaria phloem markers (Guillotin et al. 2023 Nature; scRNA only).
GARP MYB (ZmGLK34 ortholog), uncharacterized; sorghum phloem DE pct 0.47 vs 0.01, conserved grass phloem marker (Guillotin et al. 2023 Nature).
Extensin-like HMA-domain protein (uncharacterized); top sorghum phloem DE gene, pct 0.72 vs 0.03 (Guillotin et al. 2023 Nature).

DYW-type PPR protein; phloem DE pct 0.22 vs 0.01 in sorghum, maize ortholog Zm00001d049606 phloem by HCR (Guillotin et al. 2023 Nature). Conflict: endodermis-enriched in maize bulk sorted-cell data (Ortiz-Ramirez et al. 2021).

Polygalacturonase; weak Young_Phloem DE (pct 0.14 vs 0.03) and weak stele HCR puncta (Guillotin et al. 2023 Nature ED Fig 8e). The probe table names a different target for this probe: treat the HCR as unconfirmed.
X8-domain plasmodesmata callose-binding-like protein; Young_Phloem (early phloem) DE pct 0.27 vs 0.03 (Guillotin et al. 2023 Nature).
DOF TF (ZmDOF13 ortholog), PEAR-like role not verified; Young_Phloem DE pct 0.18 vs 0.02, also pericycle (Guillotin et al. 2023 Nature).

Grass SUT1 sucrose/H+ symporter for phloem loading (maize sut1 mutant); weakly phloem-enriched in sorghum root (pct 0.16 vs 0.06; also pericycle; Guillotin et al. 2023 Nature). Conflict: Venado et al. 2026 bioRxiv in situ "endodermis marker" Zm00001eb005460 is ZmSUT1 by ID (UniProt/Gramene), not a glutaredoxin as the text says.

Secondary-wall cellulose synthase (Ensembl Compara: AT4G18780 CESA8/IRX1); sorghum HCR in xylem files (Guillotin et al. 2023 Nature ED Fig 8c), xylem DE pct 0.10 vs 0.004. Also in fibers/sclerenchyma.

Xylem cysteine protease of tracheary-element PCD (ZmCCP5 ortholog); top sorghum xylem DE gene, pct 0.58 vs 0.09, log2FC 4.5 (Guillotin et al. 2023 Nature); same gene is the XCP1 xylem marker of sorghum_leaf.tsv.
Secondary-wall cellulose synthase (Ensembl Compara: AT5G44030 CESA4; ZmCesA10); xylem DE pct 0.21 vs 0.01 (Guillotin et al. 2023 Nature; scRNA only). Also in fibers.
NAC in the VND4/5/6 clade (Ensembl Compara many-to-many: AT1G12260, AT1G62700, AT5G62380); xylem DE pct 0.19 vs 0.004 (Guillotin et al. 2023 Nature; scRNA only).

HD-ZIP III REVOLUTA ortholog (Ensembl Compara: AT5G60690), xylem-side vascular regulator; sorghum xylem DE pct 0.31 vs 0.03, also columella 0.14 vs 0.04 (Guillotin et al. 2023 Nature). Conflict: sorghum_root_Guillotin2023.tsv lists it as Columella only.
HD-ZIP III; Ensembl Compara ortholog is AT1G52150 CORONA/ATHB15 (review called it HB8-like); HD-ZIP IIIs mark procambium/xylem precursors. Stele_2 DE pct 0.39 vs 0.05 (Guillotin et al. 2023 Nature).

SHORT-ROOT ortholog (Ensembl Compara: AT4G37650; ZmSHR2 ortholog per Guillotin Supp Table 1) transcribed in stele; weak stele HCR (Guillotin et al. 2023 Nature ED Fig 8f) and not a sorghum DE gene, so low counts are expected.

Zn/Cd P1B-ATPase, one-to-one ortholog of OsHMA2 (Ensembl Compara), which loads Zn/Cd into xylem from root pericycle (Yamaji et al. 2013 Plant Cell); sorghum pericycle DE pct 0.27 vs 0.06 (Guillotin et al. 2023 Nature; scRNA only).

Non-specific lipid transfer protein; pericycle DE pct 0.32 vs 0.04, log2FC 3.2 (Guillotin et al. 2023 Nature). ID ambiguous: maize Zm00001d003757 maps to Sobic.006G074200 and .006G074300 in Supp Table 1.
Clade II SWEET; pericycle DE pct 0.25 vs 0.04, also phloem and Stele_2 (Guillotin et al. 2023 Nature).
Class III peroxidase (Ensembl Compara top hit AT5G66390 PER72); clean endodermal ring by sorghum HCR in 3 experiments (Guillotin et al. 2023 Nature ED Fig 8d, Fig 2b); endodermis DE pct 0.17 vs 0.02.

SCARECROW ortholog (Ensembl Compara: AT3G54220; ZmSCR1 per Guillotin Supp Table 1) of endodermis/QC specification. Sorghum HCR gave essentially no signal and it is not a sorghum DE gene (Guillotin et al. 2023 Nature ED Fig 8h): verify enrichment in data.
Aluminum-activated malate transporter family; endodermis DE pct 0.32 vs 0.06, conserved grass endodermis marker (Guillotin et al. 2023 Nature).
Class III peroxidase; endodermis DE pct 0.20 vs 0.02, log2FC 2.1 (Guillotin et al. 2023 Nature).
L-gulonolactone oxidase-like; endodermis DE pct 0.25 vs 0.03; maize ortholog HCR labelled endodermis but the signal sits in the tip region (Guillotin et al. 2023 Nature ED Fig 7g).
GH17 beta-1,3/1,4-glucanase (lichenase-like); Cortex_3 DE pct 0.43 vs 0.04, log2FC 3.1 (Guillotin et al. 2023 Nature). Cortex_3 is the mucilage-gene domain; subtype position unvalidated.
Fatty acyl-CoA reductase (suberin primary alcohols); Cortex_4 DE pct 0.34 vs 0.04 (Guillotin et al. 2023 Nature). May mark outer cortex/hypodermis precursors (inferred, not validated).
GT47 xyloglucan galactosyltransferase; shared by Epidermis_2/3 and Trichoblast clusters (pct 0.31-0.54 vs 0.06-0.07; Guillotin et al. 2023 Nature): pan-epidermal in the root tip.

Alpha-expansin; Trichoblast 0.85 vs 0.17, Epidermis_3 0.75 vs 0.18 (Guillotin et al. 2023 Nature). Broad background expression; grass root epidermis is not position-patterned, so not a trichoblast marker.
Alpha-expansin; LRC DE pct 0.22 vs 0.015 (Guillotin et al. 2023 Nature).
Alpha-expansin; LRC DE pct 0.47 vs 0.08, also Cortex_4 0.32 vs 0.09 (Guillotin et al. 2023 Nature).

Galactoside 2-alpha-L-fucosyltransferase; columella DE pct 0.22 vs 0.03 (Guillotin et al. 2023 Nature). ID ambiguous: maize Zm00001d053327 maps to Sobic.004G124800/.125100/.125300 in Supp Table 1. Sorghum columella diverged from maize per the paper.
Mannose-6-phosphate isomerase; sorghum HCR labels cap cells, moderate (Guillotin et al. 2023 Nature ED Fig 8g), but it is not a sorghum columella DE gene.
CDC20/FZR APC/C activator (Ensembl Compara: AT5G13840 FZR3/CCS52B), G2/M; sorghum G2_M DE pct 0.30 vs 0.04 (Guillotin et al. 2023 Nature).
Kinesin motor protein (KP1-like); G2_M DE pct 0.32 vs 0.04 (Guillotin et al. 2023 Nature).

RTx430 v2.1 ID (not BTx623); no BTx623 mapping (Phytozome login). Protein kinase domain protein; in situ signal in border cells at the mucilage zone of sorghum aerial roots, rank-2 DE in S12 Border cells (Venado et al. 2026 bioRxiv Fig 2G, SD1).

RTx430 v2.1 ID (not BTx623); no BTx623 mapping (Phytozome login). Callose synthase; in situ in outer cap cells (Venado et al. 2026 bioRxiv Fig 2H) but broad in snRNA and rank-2 DE in the S8 Endodermis cluster. Authors' maize orthologs Zm00001eb148030/Zm00001eb367780 map (Ensembl) to BTx623 SORBI_3003G355200, a candidate only.

RTx430 v2.1 ID (not BTx623); no BTx623 mapping (Phytozome login). Top DE gene of S11 (wet-only "Root cap"); SD1 says "in situ validated for Root Cap" but the main-text probe is 04G115800 (Venado et al. 2026 bioRxiv).

REVIEW: RTx430 v2.1 ID (not BTx623); no BTx623 mapping (Phytozome login). Authors call it the ortholog of their maize in situ endodermis marker Zm00001eb005460 "glutaredoxin" (Venado et al. 2026 bioRxiv Fig 2F, 3E), but that maize ID is ZmSUT1 (UniProt/Gramene; Ensembl ortholog SORBI_3001G488700 SbSUT1, phloem in Guillotin 2023). Gene identity or cell type is wrong.
